note: Alberta Parks campground in Garner Lake Provincial Park, 5 km north of Spedden (50 km east of Smoky Lake on Hwy 28), in boreal forest west of the day-use beach; hiking and mountain-bike trails. The boat launch has been hand-launch only since August 2025 because of low lake levels. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jul 23, 2026) and shop: 61 sites (37 unserviced C$30, 24 power 15/30 A C$38), 20-61 ft, no pull-throughs; showers, flush and vault toilets, taps, dump; season May 14 - Sep 8 unchanged; reservable on the shop. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~480 m off (on a cottage cluster south of the road) - move recommended. Phone 780-594-7856.
